exposure: location of strain measurement (basal to apical)
cohort: Infants, including those with severe and critical pulmonary stenosis and healthy controls.
finding: Right ventricle regional strain differed significantly between infants with pulmonary stenosis and controls, and while there was significant change in strain values from basal to apical locations within the heart, there were no significant differences between pre- and post-procedural strain values in infants with pulmonary stenosis.
